theorems.name: Submission.lpf_locally_lipschitz_image
theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q), LocallyLipschitzOn U f → (∀ Z ⊆ U, (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) Z = 0 → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (f '' Z) = 0) ∧ ∀ A ⊆ U, NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → SigmaFinite ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A) → NullMeasurableSet (f '' A) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
